source: Reserve Bank of India — Weekly Statistical Supplement, foreign-exchange reserves as on 2026-11-13 (published 2026-11-20).
notes: Reserves are US$705,341.65 million as on 2026-11-13. Annual merchandise imports are FY2025-26 provisional US$775,713 million (RBI Bulletin, 2026-10-23). Short-term external debt is original maturity up to one year, end-June 2026 provisional US$153,509 million. Import cover (reserves ÷ imports × 12) and reserves ÷ short-term debt are derived from these published figures, not RBI-published ratios for 2026-11-13; RBI's own BoP-basis cover differs. Sources: https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/WSSView.aspx?Id=28849 ; https://rbidocs.rbi.org.in/rdocs/Bulletin/PDFs/32T_231020264A97C8EE38CC422EBCE9D7E6883DEF1C.PDF ; https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63700
caveats: Reserve valuation changes with gold prices, exchange rates and bond yields.
RBI reported 23.0% short-term/original-maturity debt to reserves at end-June 2026 on its own basis.
